## What this letter says
Your dating scan showed that you are 10 weeks pregnant. The scan was on 22 September 2026.
The letter asks you to continue your sertraline.
The letter also gives your booking appointment with the midwife. It is on Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00.

## What you need to do
1. Continue taking your sertraline 50 milligrams once a day.

## Dates and medicines
- Dating scan: 22 September 2026.
- Booking appointment with the midwife: 13 October 2026 at 10:00.
- Sertraline: 50 milligrams, once a day. Continue this medicine.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Is there anything else I need to know about my sertraline?
- What will happen at my booking appointment with the midwife?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
